then.name: core-70-review
then.task: Review and merge the PR for ChemE-as-Code/core#70. Check that behaviour without the new input is unchanged (golden files), the schema/ADR/skill/manifest updates, tests, and the PR's report on the ammonia-1 scratch check. Other fix PRs (#70, #71, #72) run in parallel and may touch the same shared files (CHANGELOG, ADR numbers, skills manifest): merge origin/main first and resolve. If not justified, do not merge; say what is needed.
